item.title: Dewanatron Swarmatron Synthesizer
item.description: via this Reverb listing "Fully working, very nice and clean used condition from a non smoking mixing studio. Used on one film project only. It usually takes a time to build this and it took me nearly 3month to received it from the Dewanatron. It has UK power plug but this was built to operate on any voltage between 100v - 240v."

item.title: PlantsSystem-S&H
item.description: video upload by plantssystem "Their latest track, 'S&H' is inspired by the Sample & Hold (S&H) function of analog synthesizers. It 'holds' a continuous signal at set intervals, depicting changes like stepped voltage - this characteristic is expressed through the musical structure and groove. item.title: Paul McCartney - Wonderful Christmastime
item.description: video upload by "Official music video for 'Wonderful Christmastime' performed by Paul McCartney." Sequential Circuits Prophet-5 and I believe a Hohner Clavinet D6 in the video. Some say a Yamaha CS80 was used in the recording for the lead pluck sound.
